fields.label: Model Override

fields.options:
Upload a title, bill of sale, or listing from the Dealer Vehicle list (Import from Document) or from a vehicle (Update from Document). The document is read by Claude, matched to an existing vehicle by VIN, and you review every change before it is saved.

Configure your Anthropic API key in AI Settings. Use this page only if you need a different model for document import.
